software_or_estimator: Python/scikit-learn-style tabular regression pipeline; environment defined in requirements.txt and environment.yml
feature_input: GC, sequence length, 6-mer counts, selected multi-6-mer interactions, windowed, condition-gated, dynamic condition-weighted and residual-rescue features
split_or_cv_strategy: Source-provided split where available; otherwise random or group-shuffle-by-condition split as reported per track
random_seed: 42 for model-ready random/group splits in ceiling/confirmation runs
scaling_or_normalization: Targets and feature matrices were harmonized per branch; no cross-track target pooling for headline evidence
feature_selection: Top 128 char6 features and up to 512 multi-6-mer interaction features in configured runs
hardware_parallelization: n_jobs=6 for model-ceiling runs when parallel estimators were used

feature_input: Grammar-derived public-data proxy features for mutational-prior, selection-potential, latent/operator, observable-alignment, and uncertainty/acquisition roles
split_or_cv_strategy: Track-specific split reported in Table S1; evidence class assigned before interpretation
random_seed: 42 where random split generation was required
bootstrap_repeats: 1000 for primary evidence bootstrap where prediction files were available
key_hyperparameters: Proxy construction tied to source branch; no fitted evolutionary likelihood claimed
scaling_or_normalization: Target normalization follows each processed branch target definition
feature_selection: Proxy features were interpreted by module role rather than selected post hoc for headline claim
hardware_parallelization: Computed on local workstation; full scripts and paths recorded in run configuration files

software_or_estimator: scikit-learn-compatible Ridge, ElasticNet, Nystroem kernel ridge/SVR-like, ExtraTrees, RandomForest, HistGradientBoosting, MLPRegressor
feature_input: ATLAS-Evo grammar/proxy feature matrices and matched baseline feature matrices
split_or_cv_strategy: test_size=0.2 where random split was generated; source split retained where available
key_hyperparameters: Ridge alpha=1.0; ElasticNet alpha=0.001, l1_ratio=0.15; Nystroem components=256, gamma=0.5; tree n_estimators=160, max_depth=18, min_samples_leaf=3; HGB max_iter=220, learning_rate=0.06, max_leaf_nodes=31, l2=0.01; MLP max_iter=100
scaling_or_normalization: Feature matrices were numeric tabular inputs; model-specific regularization used for linear heads

software_or_estimator: scikit-learn-compatible tree/boosting/MLP heads attached to ATLAS-Evo proxy features
feature_input: Observable-alignment, uncertainty/acquisition, selection-potential and full-theory ATLAS-Evo feature/proxy matrices
split_or_cv_strategy: Same split as corresponding track; related/prediction-derived runs interpreted as capacity audits unless independently eligible
key_hyperparameters: MLP hidden_layers=[256,64], alpha=1e-4, learning_rate_init=0.001, max_iter=250; ensemble_n=3; latent_dim=12 in strict MLP confirmation
scaling_or_normalization: No re-labelling of targets across tracks; prediction-derived responses retained only for capacity analysis
feature_selection: Same char6 and multi-6-mer feature limits as model-ceiling runs
hardware_parallelization: Local workstation; selected parallel steps used n_jobs=6 in model-ceiling layer
